about: The cues of the board-motion prototype (issue #87): every visible change it animates or marks, what starts it, who may see it, what fact it rests on, where it is drawn, how long, how it is cancelled, what stays when it ends, and what reduced motion shows instead. Six are the reviewed cues of design/contract/motion-cues.json, kept with their ids and durations; the rest are proposals of this work. None is owner-approved.
rules: A cue adds no fact: what it marks is already on screen in words (a status line, a strip line, a tag, the readable list).
A cue changes nothing and nothing waits for it: no health, resource, turn, phase, deadline or command depends on it. It is never queued.

Public cues are started only by a change between two drawn public states (seats' location, health, jailed, captain, revealed faction; active seat; phase; round; the published tally). A replayed snapshot, a reconnect, a page that was in the background, and more than four moves in one update play no travel.

Private cues are drawn only on the acting player's own board while their own action is open, from their own view's offers, their own taps and their own receipts. Closing, backgrounding, a stale view, time running out or a new phase removes them.

No cue exists for a shot, a shooter, a weapon, an attack type, a block, Protection, a Rescue giver, a Supply giver, a Hack partner or any cause, on any surface. A health change is drawn the same whatever caused it.
No cue has a sound, a vibration pattern, a light change in a room or a fetched picture. All pictures are in the bundles every device loads before the first view.
Cue layers take no pointer events and cannot take focus. A newer authoritative state withdraws the cue in flight for the same seat; the latest state is what is drawn.
Reduced motion: no travel, trail, shake, lift or zoom. Arrival, status changes, stamps and sheets use the 80 ms fade. The facts and the controls are the same.

cues.trigger: The player presses Actions while nothing is in progress.
cues.facts: The actions the player's own view opens (legalTargets keys, availability flags). Nothing public.
cues.cancellation: Closing the tray, choosing an action, or any change that closes the private surface.
cues.settled: The tray is open over the lower board; the board stays visible above it.

cues.trigger: An action, a room move or Pass starts its strip.
cues.facts: The player's own choice.
cues.cancellation: Going back to nothing in progress.
cues.settled: The strip sits in its own row above navigation; the board shrinks, nothing is covered.
cues.reduced: No rise; it is simply there.

cues.trigger: An action that names players is chosen.
cues.facts: Exactly the seats the player's own view offers for it (legalTargets, or every seat for a Code attempt), minus those already picked.
cues.cancellation: Back, a pick that completes the choice, a fresh view that no longer offers the seat, closing, backgrounding, a stale view, time running out, a new phase.
cues.settled: A dashed ring at the character's base, a + tab, and a 44 px press area on the character; the others are drawn faint. Words: the strip says Tap a character.
cues.reduced: The same (a state, not a motion).
cues.asset: None: CSS ring. The approved token-emphasis.ring-targetable is its picture in the reviewed kit.

cues.trigger: The player taps an eligible character (one-target actions, ballots).
cues.facts: The player's own tap.
cues.cancellation: Choose again; any change that drops the choice.
cues.settled: Lifted by --ms-lift, solid ring, check stamp. The strip asks to confirm in the release's words.
cues.reduced: No lift; the ring and stamp are drawn at once.

cues.trigger: Each pick of a Supply (two) or a Code attempt (four).
cues.facts: The player's own taps, in order. The order is a visual aid, not an ordered Code.
cues.cancellation: Take back removes the last pick; any change that drops the choice removes all.
cues.settled: Numbered stamp on the character; filled progress dots in the strip; Chosen so far in words.

cues.trigger: Confirm is pressed; the request is on its way, or a check is running.
cues.facts: The player's own request in flight. Not a result.
cues.cancellation: The receipt, or the outcome becoming unknown.
cues.settled: A dotted ring and an ellipsis stamp on the chosen characters; a dashed Sending stamp in the strip. Nothing moves while waiting.

cues.trigger: An accepted receipt for this device's own command (REGISTERED).
cues.facts: The receipt: accepted, registered. Not hit, healed, protected, scanned right or successful.
cues.anchor: .bm-stamp[data-kind=registered] in the strip, never on the board
cues.cancellation: Done; any change that closes the private surface.
cues.settled: The same Registered stamp and the release's receipt words for every action; the board's private marks are gone.

cues.trigger: A rejected receipt (PHASE_CLOSED, NOT_ALLOWED) or a safe failure.
cues.facts: The receipt or failure code, in the release's words.
cues.cancellation: OK.
cues.settled: A hatched Not accepted stamp (no red), the release's words, OK.

cues.trigger: No usable answer: the outcome is unknown.
cues.facts: That the device does not know. Nothing more.
cues.cancellation: Check again and an answer.
cues.settled: A dotted Unknown stamp, the release's words, Check again. No motion that would suggest either outcome.

cues.trigger: A room name tag is pressed.
cues.facts: The press. The same neutral public button on every phone; whether a move is possible is checked by the player's own controller after the press.
cues.cancellation: Ends by itself.
cues.settled: The caption as before.

cues.trigger: A legal room tag is pressed: a move is being confirmed or sent.
cues.facts: The player's own choice among their view's movementDestinations.
cues.cancellation: Choose again; not accepted; the authoritative move arriving.
cues.settled: A dashed outline of the player's own figure with You?, in the pressed room. The real piece stays where the server has it.
cues.asset: The player's own figure, standing, from the figure bundle (public art).

cues.trigger: Card or Menu is pressed.
cues.facts: The player's own view (role, knowledge, acknowledgments) for Card; public facts for Menu.
cues.cancellation: Closing; backgrounding closes Card.
cues.settled: A sheet over the lower board; the board stays visible above it.
cues.asset: Card: piece-crew card picture with the role's held device (roles bundle), inside .bm-private only.

cues.trigger: A drawn public state shows a seat in another location than the state before (PUBLIC_MOVE), four or fewer in one update.
cues.facts: seats[].location before and after. Nothing about why: a move, a transfer to Hospital or Jail, a release and the Final Zone transfer look the same.
cues.anchor: .bm-flyer in the board's .bm-fx layer, walking from its feet at the old station to its feet at the new
cues.cancellation: A newer change to the same seat; a reconnect; the page going to the background.
cues.settled: The piece at its new station; an ink trail and a landing puff fade out by 900 ms. Each character's lift and settle angle is its own public flourish (fixtures CREW: hop, settle).
cues.reduced: No flight: the piece appears at its new station with an 80 ms fade.
cues.asset: The figure bundle: the character in the walking pose, facing the way it goes; fx-ink-trail.paper; fx-landing-puff.paper.

cues.trigger: A move into or out of a room changes the stations of those already there.
cues.facts: Public occupancy only.
cues.cancellation: Any newer change to that seat.
cues.settled: Everyone at the station their seat order gives them.
cues.reduced: None: they are simply at their stations.

cues.trigger: A drawn public state shows another health (PUBLIC_HEALTH_CHANGED), jailed flag, Captain flag or revealed faction for a seat than the state before.
cues.facts: seats[].health, jailed, captain, revealedFaction. Never who caused it or how.
cues.cancellation: A newer change to the same seat.
cues.settled: The marker on the piece and the status words in its name; Injured characters lean a little; Eliminated ones are grey with the faction the rules reveal.

cues.trigger: The active seat changes.
cues.facts: activeSeatId.
cues.cancellation: The next change of turn.
cues.settled: The turn marker above the head, still; the status bar names the turn.

cues.trigger: PHASE_CHANGED within a round (a new turn, Hack, a vote, the showdown).
cues.facts: phase.kind, activeSeatId.
cues.cancellation: The next phase change.
cues.settled: The status bar's words and timer. Its size never changes.

cues.trigger: PHASE_CHANGED with a higher round.
cues.facts: round.
cues.anchor: .bm-status__round and a caption band sweeping under the status bar
cues.cancellation: The next phase change.
cues.settled: The round chip says the new round.

cues.trigger: A vote closes and the view carries lastTally.
cues.facts: The published aggregate counts and the selected seat. Never an individual ballot.
cues.cancellation: The next tally or phase that clears it.
cues.settled: A count label on each counted character; the selected one in caption yellow.

cues.trigger: A release vote opens.
cues.facts: ballot.releaseTargetSeatId (public).
cues.cancellation: The vote closing.
cues.settled: A double ring and On the ballot on the jailed character.

notProduced.what: Any effect for a shot, Disable, Protection, Rescue, Hack, Scan, Supply or Code attempt on a public surface
notProduced.why: Not authorized: no public event discloses an attacker, weapon, block, giver or cause (the view and event schemas of packages/contracts/src/full-game.ts).

notProduced.what: A BANG, projectile, impact, heal or shield on a health change
notProduced.why: PUBLIC_HEALTH_CHANGED says only the new health. Drawing a cause would invent a fact.
No audio asset exists; a sound or vibration per action would disclose private activity to anyone in earshot.
Tokens say loops: false; nothing moves while nothing happens (DSN-D16).
